The first ship attempt was refused by the gate. The new check failed on the pipe bundles because the sprite builder only bakes 2 sprites a frame and there are many distinct pipe pieces. The game code was fine, so I changed the check to warm up until every piece has its sprite, up to 40 frames. After that the new check passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).
